notes.title: Join The Playtest Now – Dive into the Pools!
notes.content: [p]Hey, adventurers! The Playtest for Ripple Park is live and ready for you to dive in! Try the latest build, explore the world being crafted, and help shape the game with your feedback. Whether you’re a veteran or just curious, this is your chance to experience Ripple Park before its official launch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464221/9fcebb60812b39c84c8a49ad37c3221061d0f6e9.png"][/img][/p][p]To join, head to the Ripple Park Steam page and click “Request Access” in the Playtest section. It’s that simple – no wait, just gameplay! Your input means a lot in making Ripple Park better, so come play and share your thoughts. [/p][p]The Playtest is ongoing, so don’t miss out. See you in-game![/p][p]– Phase Wanderer[/p]
